summary: Town and postcode columns in the main table, and click-to-sort headings on CAPACITY, COUNTY, TOWN, POSTCODE and REPD UPDATED. Town is resolved from the postcode through the ONS Postcode Directory at build time; the table makes no network call.
modification_note: This cartridge is NOT panel-only. It adds two columns to the project table and makes four headings sortable, so it patches the table renderer and the sort model in app.mjs. Every patch is a declared, counted replacement; rollback is --from an earlier release, as always.

index.html.label: styling for the sortable headings + locality provenance note
index.html.to:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/202608272048-orientation.css">
  <style>
    /* Matches .repd-updated-heading, which was the only sortable heading
       before this generation. Same affordance, so the table reads as one
       control surface rather than one special column plus four new ones. */
    .sortable-heading button {
      background: transparent; border: 0; color: inherit; cursor: pointer;
      font: inherit; font-weight: bold; padding: 0; text-align: left;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .sortable-heading button:hover,
    .sortable-heading button:focus-visible { color: #fff; outline: 1px solid #00ffff; outline-offset: 4px; }
    .sortable-heading span { color: #ffcc00; }
    .locality-cell { white-space: nowrap; }
    .locality-cell .derived { color: #8d98a5; }
    .locality-note { color: #8d98a5; font-size: 9px; }
  </style>

provenance.postcode: DESNZ Renewable Energy Planning Database, column 'Post Code', Open Government Licence v3.0. Copied, never derived.
provenance.town: Resolved at build time from the REPD postcode via the ONS Postcode Directory (api.postcodes.io), preferring ONS Built-Up Area, then civil parish, then electoral ward. Where the register carries no postcode, the last usable segment of the REPD Address line is used and marked town_source='derived'. Null where unsourceable; never guessed.
provenance.authority: DESNZ REPD, column 'Planning Authority', OGL v3.0. Carried in the payload. NOTE: the gridatlas study spine (master.tsv) carries this same planning-authority value in a column it calls 'town'. It is the local planning authority, not a settlement -- 'Scottish Government (S36)' is one of its values. This cartridge keeps the two apart.
